data.description:
## Goal

Pin the off-peak-windowed, all-opencode low-priority fallback behaviour with tests **before** the config change (test-first).

## Scope

Tests only; no production behaviour change in this item.

## Work

1. **Window gating:** an `available_times`-carrying entry is skipped outside its UTC window (`_is_within_allowed_window` → `Skipping provider=...: outside its available_times window (UTC)`) and selected inside it.
2. **Chain order:** `priority_routes.low` for plan/author/code resolves to `local-qwen3 → munitoai-free → opencode-go-3 → opencode-go-2 → opencode-go`. (Red until the config item lands — intended TDD state; document the convention if the repo requires green main.)
3. **Per-key 429 failover (the key behaviour):** a 429 from `opencode-go-3` must NOT exclude `opencode-go-2` / `opencode-go` from the same request — rate-limit quarantine is keyed on `_usage_limit_account_key` (`api_key_env@endpoint`), so sibling accounts are independent (LP-0MSMBWB23009XYPW, LP-0MVCX0E2V001VB5N).
4. **Same-domain 5xx caveat:** a 5xx from `opencode-go-3` DOES exclude its same-gateway siblings as one failure domain (`_failure_domain_key` / `attempted_domains`, LP-0MSG45I8Q0020N1F) — assert the honest behaviour so nobody assumes 3× outage resilience.
5. **No paid-tier leak:** `munitoai` and `deepseek-flash` never appear in any `low` chain.
6. **Medium/high unaffected:** those chains are unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Tests cover in-window selection, out-of-window skip-and-fall-through, and behaviour-neutrality when the free tier still has budget.
2. A test asserts the exact 5-entry low chain order for plan, author and code.
3. A test asserts 429-per-account failover lets sibling opencode keys be tried in the same request.
4. A test asserts 5xx does NOT give sibling failover (same failure domain).
5. A test asserts `munitoai` / `deepseek-flash` absent from `low` chains and `medium`/`high` chains unchanged.
6. Reuses existing proxy test conventions (monkeypatched clock for `available_times`, existing timing-gate fixtures) rather than inventing new harness code.
7. full suite green via `/skill:test`, except the documented intentional red chain-order assertion pending the config item.
data.title: Test: off-peak low-priority fallback gating
